faqs.question: Do I need a doctor's consultation for detox protocols?
faqs.answer: Yes. All our medical detox protocols require a consultation with a licensed medical doctor. Our doctor will evaluate your symptoms and order targeted lab tests before prescribing your plan.

faqs.question: What does the doctor-guided detox program include?
faqs.answer: Your program includes a full medical consultation, specialized urine or blood lab testing, custom prescription binders or antifungals, eating guidelines, and follow-up check-ins.

faqs.question: How do I know if I have mold toxins or gut bugs?
faqs.answer: We order simple, painless lab tests (such as a urine mycotoxin panel or gut stool test) that pinpoint exactly what toxins or microbes are causing your brain fog and bloating.

faqs.question: Will I experience uncomfortable detox side effects?
faqs.answer: Our doctors start your plan gently to avoid 'detox crashes'. We adjust your binder dose to make sure toxins are removed smoothly without disrupting your daily routine.

faqs.question: How long does a medical detox protocol take?
faqs.answer: Most patients complete their main cleansing phase in 6 to 12 weeks, with major improvements in brain fog, energy, and digestion appearing within the first 3 to 4 weeks.

faqs.question: How do I get started with a clinical detox?
faqs.answer: Getting started is simple! Call our clinic today at (727) 476-8966 or click 'Book Your Doctor Consultation' online. Our doctor will order your lab test and start your plan!
